_note: The two Réseau géodésique du Québec stations that speak NTRIP. Both mountpoints were probed live on 2026-08-11 (142.41.245.88:2107 and :2103, one STR row each); the ministry's sourcetable rows carry no coordinates, so the positions come from its own station register at source_url. Each station sits on its own port, hence the per-station `port`. The network's other sixteen stations emit raw RTCM on a plain socket with no mountpoint and are therefore not stations this layer can pin - see the ca_qc_mrnf_tcp element.
